name: Guilherme Kodama
lede: I build software that puts language models next to things that must not go wrong: a ledger with real money, public spending records, my own repositories. I design each system around what it must never do, and I run it myself.

based.label: based
based.value: São Paulo (UTC−3), remote with international teams

sentence: Three systems, one pattern: in each, the proposal that must not go wrong waits at <line>this line</line>.

legend.gate: the line: where a person, or a check that fails closed, decides
